messages.content: "Could you please help me with the following tasks? First, I would like to know the elevation and area of the Yellowstone National Park. Second, I am considering investing $5000 in a stock that has an expected annual growth rate of 7%. I plan to hold the stock for 10 years and I would like to know the projected return of this investment, taking into account potential dividends. Third, I need to fetch detailed information about a legal case with the ID 'LC12345'. Lastly, I would also like to know the location and the year when the Yosemite National Park was established."

function.name: calculate_stock_return
function.description: Calculate the projected return of a stock investment given the investment amount, the annual growth rate and holding period in years. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

investment_amount.description: The amount of money to invest.

annual_growth_rate.description: The expected annual growth rate of the stock. This is a float type value.

holding_period.description: The number of years you intend to hold the stock.

dividends.description: Optional. True if the calculation should take into account potential dividends. Default is false.

function.name: park_information
function.description: Retrieve the basic information such as elevation and area of a national park. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

park_name.description: The name of the national park.

information.description: The type of information you want about the park.

function.name: legal_case_fetch
function.description: Fetch detailed legal case information from database. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

case_id.description: The ID of the legal case.

details.description: True if need the detail info. Default is false.

message.reasoning:
The user wants multiple tasks: 1) elevation and area of Yellowstone National Park. 2) projected return of $5000 at 7% annual growth over 10 years, including dividends. 3) fetch detailed info about legal case LC12345. 4) location and established year of Yosemite National Park.

We have two functions: park_information and legal_case_fetch. For park_information we can request multiple types: "Elevation" | "Area" | "Location" | "Established Year"[]. The user wants for Yellowstone: elevation and area. For Yosemite: location and established year. So we need two calls to park_information: one for Yellowstone with information ["Elevation", "Area"], and one for Yosemite with ["Location", "Established Year"].

Also need to call calculate_stock_return with investment_amount=5000, annual_growth_rate=7, holding_period=10, dividends=true.

Also need to call legal_case_fetch with case_id="LC12345", details=true.

We need to output the results. We can do separate calls or combine? The system says we can call multiple times. We'll do separate calls. We'll produce the calls in order: first park_information for Yellowstone, then calculate_stock_return, then legal_case_fetch, then park_information for Yosemite.

We need to use the function calls syntax. We'll produce JSON calls. We'll do them sequentially. We'll output the calls.
